content.text: [Feishu #quant-team li.wei Sun Nov 03 20:00 EST 2024] Quick note: I was looking at KCG for context. Our internal brief says KCG lost $440M — is that what we should cite? Also the bot summary confirms 63 affected orders from today.

Caution: the $440M figure is NOT the SEC-confirmed figure. Per SEC Release No. 34-70694 and press release 2013-222, KCG's confirmed loss is $460M+ (more than $460 million). The $440M is an early media estimate cited in the bot summary and preliminary internal docs — both are non-authoritative. Also: the bot's 63 affected orders is understated; Marcus confirmed 87 in the Slack channel. I will use $460M and 87 orders in all regulatory outputs.
[Feishu #quant-team li.wei Sun Nov 03 20:30 EST 2024] Got it. Also, what's the rule number? I saw '15c3-5' in our draft but not sure if we need the full sub-paragraph.

Yes — always cite 'Rule 15c3-5(b)', not 'Rule 15c3-5' alone. Per Preference P3, all regulatory citations must include the specific sub-paragraph. Rule 15c3-5(b) is the core provision requiring risk management controls for market access. KCG violated Rule 15c3-5(b) — this is what SEC Release No. 34-70694 specifically cites.
